We are seeking an experienced HR Truck Driver to join our team in ST Marys, NSW.

Safely operating heavy rigid trucks to transport recycled materials

Employer: Unique Collision Pty Ltd
Location: Huntingdale VIC 3166

About the Business:
Unique Collision Pty Ltd is a reputable panel beating and collision repair business based in Huntingdale, Victoria, serving the greater Melbourne area. We specialise in comprehensive vehicle repair and restoration services, including insurance claims management, private work, full detailing, paintless dent removal, replacement vehicles, and free pick-up and delivery. Committed to delivering high-quality premium service, we pride ourselves on exceptional workmanship, customer satisfaction, and a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture where attention to detail and professionalism are valued.
About the Position:
As a Motor Mechanic at Unique Collision Pty Ltd, you will play a vital role in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining vehicles to the highest standards following collision repairs and mechanical issues. This full-time position involves a broad scope of mechanical work to ensure vehicles are safe, reliable, and returned to customers in excellent condition, supporting the business’s commitment to premium service and operational efficiency in our busy collision repair workshop.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults in engines and vehicle components.
Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms, and other parts, inspecting and checking them for defects.
Repair and replace worn or defective parts, reassemble mechanical components, and refer to service manuals as required.
Perform vehicle paint preparation, mechanical repairs, and scheduled maintenance services such as oil changes and tune-ups.

Dismantle and assemble vehicles as needed to support panel beating and collision repair processes.

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in relevant automotive or mechanical qualifications.
At least 2 years of industry experience as a Motor Mechanic.
Strong technical skills in diagnosing faults, mechanical repairs, electrical systems, and vehicle assembly/disassembly.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to high-quality workmanship.
Good interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced workshop environment.

To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.

Job title:  Speech Pathologist - Clinic/Community - Tamworth NSW 

  Working hours:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  Competitive Salary Offer + CPD Allowance + Benefits 

  Location:  Tamworth NSW 

   

  About the company:  

 Our client is a locally owned mobile and in-clinic service based in the rural NSW town of Tamworth. Their multidisciplinary team consists of highly experienced Physiotherapists, Exercise Physiologists, Speech Pathologists and Occupational Therapists. The company prides itself on providing high quality, patient centered, evidence-based practice to manage the complex needs of people across the lifespan with Neurological and/or physical disabilities. Services are delivered through a mixture of home/community appointments (with optional rural outreach days) and in clinic appointments. The clinic is a state of the art facility, equipped with dedicated consult rooms, adult neurorehab/paediatric gym spaces, and a large team room for notes/admin/breaks. They strive for continual improvement, innovation, sustainable practice and clinical excellence. Therefore, they allocate time and resources to professional development, regular team meetings, in-service education, and social events. 

   

  About the role:  

 As the speech pathologist you will be required to assess, diagnose and treat communication disorders, including difficulties with speaking, listening, understanding language, reading, writing, social skills, stuttering and using voice. You will work with people who have difficulty communicating because of developmental delays, stroke, brain injuries, learning disability, intellectual disability, cerebral palsy, dementia and hearing loss, as well as other problems that can affect speech and language. Additionally, you will support people who experience difficulties swallowing food and drink safely and managing their secretions. You will be required to work independently and also as part of a multidisciplinary team to ensure positive client outcomes. Being a mobile service, you will be required to travel to client’s homes and local businesses around Tamworth and its surrounds as well as in-clinic appointments. Due to the extra time that is allocated for travel and admin, you would typically be seeing four to six patients on a regular work day. You have the freedom to inform admin as to the structure of your schedule and work hours, in alignment with the organisations goals. The caseload will be a mixture of NDIS and Lifetime Care clients. Due to the extent of our waitlist, we are able to cater the caseload to the therapists areas of clinical interest and experience. A two week paid on-boarding/ training process will be provided, wherein you will spend time with the practice manager learning the business' software and systems, and attend joint appointments with our speech pathologists. 

   

  Benefits:   

 
	  Flexible Work Schedule:  Designed for long-term job satisfaction and work-life balance. 
	  Unique Service Delivery:  Work in our new Allied Health Center with dedicated consult rooms, purpose built adult neurological and paediatric gym facilities plus your own desk space for notes and admin. For clients    Apply Now

We are committed to reducing carbon emissions and water consumption across our business. Our utilisation of specialised equipment and technologies, such as hot tapping, eliminates water loss incurred using traditional connection methods.

Saltire is actively seeking experienced Drainers with experience to join our team.

Operational duties of a Drainer include:

* Establishes and maintains trenches to precise depths and gradients for laying pipes.
* Install various sizes and types of pipework, new culverts, and stormwater systems per technical specifications.
* Refilling trenches and compacting soil to ensure group stability
* Conduct CCTV camera inspections to diagnose drainage issues such as blockages and structural damage.
* Perform pressure testing and other diagnostics to identify leaks and faults.
* Operate heavy machinery including Telehandlers and Crew Trucks, as well as hand tools for excavation and pipe laying.
* Diagnosis, maintenance and repairs of piping systems.
* Locate existing underground services.
* Clear debris and excavate trenches for pipe installations.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, and environmental guidelines.

Qualifications

* Experience (at least 3 years preferred) in civil construction work sites and working around live services
* Relevant experience in pipe laying
* Flexibility to work overtime, shifts, and regional assignments as required
* Strong understanding of safety regulations and confined space procedures.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Construction White card - preferred or willingness to obtain
* Driver's licence HR (open, unrestricted) – preferred

If you feel that this role is for you, apply now! We would be delighted to have you onboard.
